tagline: Try any Flipper Zero firmware in your browser before flashing it to your real device.
status: Pre-alpha (milestone M4). The real firmware runs instruction by instruction; see the hardware fidelity table for what is emulated, simulated or missing.
positioning: dryflash is a smoke test, not a hardware certification. It catches boot failures, crashes, faults, hangs and broken UI flows. It does not reproduce real RF, NFC/RFID physics, BLE, power behaviour or exact timing. Passing in the emulator does not guarantee the firmware works on hardware.
disclaimer: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Flipper Devices Inc. Flipper Zero is a trademark of its respective owner. For educational and authorised security research only.
privacy: The file stays in your browser: nothing is uploaded.
keyboard: Keyboard: arrows, Enter/Space = OK, Backspace/Esc = Back.
legacySleepNote: Firmware setting (Settings → System → Sleep Method). The emulated radio core has no wireless stack, so the default deep-sleep path cannot switch clocks and never sleeps; Legacy uses plain WFI. Applies at the next power cycle (ADR-0012).
installed: Quick install: {files} files from package {info} put on the card.
persist_none: Not saved: it is lost when you close this page. Another tab may be using this device, or this browser blocks storage.
eraseConfirm: Erase the whole virtual SD card? Everything on it is lost, including the device's saved settings. The device restarts.
otaMode: Real OTA: the firmware's own updater
otaNote: Needs a firmware already running here. The device restarts into its updater, which backs up, programs flash, checks it and unpacks the resources itself; this takes about a minute. Only the radio stack is left out: this emulator has no radio core to install it on (ADR-0014).
otaStarted: Real OTA of {name} ({info}) started: follow it on the screen.
deleteConfirm: Delete this virtual device with its firmware, card and settings? This cannot be undone.
factoryConfirm: Erase this device's firmware, card and settings? This cannot be undone.
applyNext: Name, region, colour and sleep method apply at the next power cycle. Battery applies at once.
cardChanges: Uploading or deleting restarts the device, so that its firmware mounts the changed card.
moreEventsLater: LED changes for now; IR, vibration and GPIO arrive with those peripherals.
gifLimit: GIF stops by itself after 30 seconds.
linkAsk: Load this firmware from a link?
viaProxy: {name} loaded from {url}, through the dryflash proxy.
compatIntro: The pinned firmwares and what has been seen working on each, checked by hand on {date}. A nightly automatic run replaces this in a later milestone.
aboutHowText: dryflash runs the real, unmodified release of a firmware on a model of the STM32WB55 written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly. Instructions are interpreted one by one; there is no server, and your files stay in your browser. The display, the buttons, the LEDs, the SD card and the flash controller are modelled from the firmware's own source.
aboutLimitsText: The radio core is a small stand-in with no wireless stack: no Bluetooth, no factory keys, and a package's radio stack is not installed. Sub-GHz, NFC and RFID have no real signals. Timing is approximate. Passing here does not prove a firmware works on hardware.
aboutCreditsText: Free software under GPL-3.0-or-later. Credits are in the repository.
quickNote: Quick install: the firmware goes straight into flash and the resources onto the card.
backupNote: One file with this device's firmware, card and settings. Importing it creates a new device.
